[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Corin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[Dorn Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], handling equipment management.

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Corin appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an Equipment Commendations Vendor for Imperial players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> he was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
